rules.topic: Scope limited to two approved pilot workflows
rules.position: The agreement covers only candidate-material summaries and interview-note drafting for human review; no broader HR system-of-record, screening, or decision-making scope.
rules.quote:
AgentCo should keep the agreement  focused on the actual TalentFlow pilot: 
 candidate-material summaries and interview-note drafting for human review

rules.topic: Expansion into ATS/scoring/background checks/payroll requires separate approval
rules.position: Any expansion beyond the pilot's two workflows (ATS integration, candidate scoring, assessments, background checks, payroll, benefits, immigration, accommodations, employee-relations data) requires a separate written approval, security review, and scoped order form.
rules.quote:
Any expansion into ATS integrations, 
 candidate scoring, assessments, background checks, payroll, beneﬁts, immigration, accommodations, or 
 employee-relations data should require a separate written approval, security review, and scoped order

rules.topic: LargeCo owns its candidate data and customer-specific outputs
rules.position: LargeCo owns its candidate materials, job requirements, prompts, configurations, and customer-specific outputs.
rules.quote:
AgentCo should  agree that LargeCo owns its candidate materials, 
 job requirements, prompts, conﬁgurations, and customer-speciﬁc outputs

rules.topic: No sale, sharing, or training on candidate data
rules.position: AgentCo will not sell, share, train on, or otherwise use candidate data outside TalentFlow.
rules.quote:
AgentCo should not sell, share, 
 train on, or use candidate data outside TalentFlow

rules.topic: AgentCo retains ownership of its platform and non-customer-specific know-how
rules.position: AgentCo keeps ownership of its platform, models, reusable workflows, prompt templates, evaluation methods, and non-customer-specific know-how.
rules.quote:
AgentCo should preserve ownership of its 
 platform, models, reusable workﬂows, prompt templates, evaluation methods, and 
 non-customer-speciﬁc know-how

rules.topic: Outputs are drafts for human review, not guaranteed hiring decisions
rules.position: TalentFlow outputs are treated as drafts for human review, not guaranteed legal, compliant, unbiased, or complete hiring decisions.
rules.quote:
TalentFlow outputs should be treated as drafts for human review, not 
 guaranteed legal, compliant, unbiased, or complete hiring decisions

rules.topic: Resist unrestricted code access, monthly scans, 99.99% uptime, 30-min resolution, 100% credits
rules.position: AgentCo resists unrestricted code access, monthly scans, uncontrolled testing, 99.99% uptime, thirty-minute resolution obligations, and automatic 100% service credits.
rules.fallback: Standard SaaS SLA with severity-based support and limited service credits.
rules.quote:
It should resist 
 unrestricted code access, monthly scans, uncontrolled testing, 99.99% uptime, thirty-minute resolution 
 obligations, and automatic 100% service credits

rules.position: Offer a standard SaaS SLA with severity-based support and limited service credits, in place of stringent uptime/credit demands.
rules.quote:
Offer a standard SaaS SLA with severity-based support 
 and limited service credits

rules.topic: Liability cap baseline: fees paid in prior 12 months
rules.position: Protect the baseline liability cap at fees paid in the prior twelve months; a targeted higher cap may be considered for confidentiality, candidate-data security, and DPA breaches.
rules.fallback: Targeted higher cap for confidentiality, candidate-data security, and DPA breaches only.
rules.quote:
AgentCo should protect the  baseline cap at fees paid in the prior 
 twelve months, 
 while considering a targeted higher cap for conﬁdentiality, candidate-data security, and DPA breaches

rules.topic: Resist unlimited liability for AI output/hiring decisions
rules.position: Resist unlimited liability for AI output issues, customer hiring decisions, unreviewed use of outputs, LargeCo's job criteria, candidate notices, workflows, or employment decisions.
rules.quote:
It 
 should resist unlimited liability for AI output issues, customer hiring decisions, unreviewed use of outputs, 
 LargeCo’s job criteria, candidate notices, workﬂows, or employment decisions

rules.topic: IP indemnity scoped to the AgentCo service with standard exclusions
rules.position: IP indemnity stays tied to the AgentCo service and standard exclusions.
rules.quote:
IP indemnity should stay 
 tied to the AgentCo service and standard exclusions

rules.topic: Security proof via SOC 2/questionnaires, reasonable annual audit
rules.position: AgentCo can provide SOC 2 or equivalent materials, questionnaires, subprocessor details, data-flow descriptions, and a reasonable annual audit process.
rules.quote:
AgentCo can provide SOC 2  or equivalent materials, questionnaires, 
 subprocessor details, data-ﬂow descriptions, and a reasonable annual audit process

rules.position: TalentFlow may support human-reviewed hiring workflows but will not make autonomous hire, reject, compensation, promotion, termination, ranking, filtering, or scoring decisions.
rules.quote:
TalentFlow may support human-reviewed hiring workﬂows, but it 
 will not make autonomous hire, reject, compensation, promotion, termination, ranking, ﬁltering, or 
 scoring decisions

rules.position: AgentCo can accept a DPA, confidentiality protections, no-training commitments, limits on use of candidate data, commercially reasonable security obligations, subprocessor notice, data export/deletion, audit logs, admin controls, and documentation describing intended use and human-review expectations.
rules.quote:
AgentCo can accept a DPA, conﬁdentiality  protections, no-training commitments, 
 limits on use of candidate data, commercially reasonable security obligations, subprocessor notice, data 
 export/deletion, audit logs, admin controls, and documentation describing intended use and 
 human-review expectations
